justification: Both surfaces reduce the human form to highly schematic outlines and use simple curved and linear strokes, but that is about all they share: A is a scattered field of tiny stick-figure people, a branching tree-like motif and a crescent boat spread over an open panel, while B is a single monumental anthropomorph whose body carries relief motifs (face, arms curving to the abdomen, a disc on the torso, banded lines). The relationships and layout differ entirely, with A having no central figure or body-as-canvas organisation and B having no multi-figure scene.
